_doc: Hidden from every list, radar and kit (PLAN v2 §7). Terms match whole words in the repo name or description, case-insensitive; '-', '_' and '.' in names count as word breaks. repos: exact owner/name. Edit freely; takes effect on the next data run. Avoid terms that also describe legitimate tools (e.g. 'cheat' hits cheat sheets, 'nsfw' hits NSFW-detection models).
